P. A. ह्वयति, -ते, जुहाव (identical in form with Perf.
of rt. हु), जुहुवे (in Ṛg-veda

. जुहूरे
= जुह्विरे), ह्वास्यति, -ते, अह्वत्, अह्वत or अह्-
वास्त, Prec. हूयात्, ह्वासीष्ट (Vedic forms

rd sing. हुवे, (आ)जुह्वे, 3rd pl.
जुहुरे, जुहूरे;

st sing. अह्वे, 3rd pl. अहू-
षत), ह्वातुम् (Ved. Inf. हवीतवे, हुवध्यै),
to call; to call to; to call upon, invoke; to chal-
lenge; to name; to seek, ask, pray, beg; to emu-
late, vie with: Pass. हूयते (identical in form with
Pass. of rt. हु), Aor. अह्वायि, &c., to be called, &c.:
Caus. ह्वाययति, -यितुम्, Aor. अजूहवत्: Desid.
of Caus. जुहावयिषति: Desid. जुहूषति, -ते:
Intens. जोहूयते, जोहवीति, जोहोति (Impf. अजोहवीत्,
3rd pl. अजोहवुः, Pres. part. जोहुवत्), to call on,
invoke; [cf. according to some, Gr. βοή, βοάω, pro-
bably ἀΰω, ἰωή; Lat. re-boare, perhaps voveo, vo-
tum; Goth. vôpjan; Old Germ. hweion, hrôfu,
ruafu; Mod. Germ. Rufe; Angl. Sax. hweop,
wepan; Old Icel. hvîa, ‘to neigh;’ Slav. zv-a-ti,
‘to call;’ Hib. guilim, ‘I bewail.’]
ह्वेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be called; to be invoked.
